{{Quote|Just what I was afraid of, I've led us right into a trap.|Unidentified captain|<ref name="ce1" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] served as the '''captain''' of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Dauntless-class heavy cruiser|''Dauntless''-class heavy cruiser]] [[Endor (Dauntless-class)|''Endor'']]. In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]], he took the ''Endor'' on a patrol near the [[Planetoid/Legends|planetoid]] [[RZ7-6113-23]] and intercepted two [[TIE/sr starfighter]]s. They tried to follow the starfighters only to be led into a [[Ambush at RZ7-6113-23|trap]]. The captain realized the trap too late and the ''Endor'' was destroyed by a single blast from the fully charged cannon.<ref name="ce1" />
